chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Seapunk, for 21 printed damage total.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered using Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi in its Block mode followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea, reducing the incoming attack by 3 while dealing 9 damage.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 3 Block, so I take the full telegraphed 11 damage instead of 8, in exchange for dealing 12 more damage and leaving Seapunk at 1 HP.
q4_different_intent: No. From the printed information, the three one-cost attacks still produce the highest known damage for the available energy, and no listed line can defeat Seapunk this turn.
